summary.text: Giovanni Capriglione represents Texas House District 98, which includes all or part of Grapevine, Colleyville, Southlake, Keller, Westlake and Euless, and was first elected in 2012. He chairs the House Delivery of Government Efficiency Committee and is a member of the Committee on Ways & Means.

paragraphs.text: Capriglione earned a BS in Physics and an MBA in Finance from Santa Clara University.
He worked for a DFW-based venture capital and private equity firm and is now owner and president of Texas Adventure Capital LLC.
He previously held positions at computer engineering companies specializing in semiconductor design and Internet products, and was senior vice president at an investment firm.
He is serving his seventh term, and has been married to his wife, Elisa, for 24 years and has three children.
